# Overview

Where does the NanoLuc reporter construct fall in the distribution of CDS length,
CDS GC%, and CDS GC3% across (a) the whole expressed MDA-MB-231 transcriptome and
(b) the mRNAs translationally promoted by eIF3d in hypoxia (1hr, `te_lfc > 0.5`,
`te_padj < 0.05`)? This is the baseline for choosing or recoding a reporter CDS.

`02_` is the MCF7-SIX1 counterpart. Everything cell-line agnostic lives in
`reporter_helpers.R`, which both notebooks source.

Adapted from `code/predictive_modeling/62_cds_length_gc_hypoxia_promotes.Rmd`, with
three deliberate changes:

1. **The NanoLuc sequence is imported, not transcribed.** It is read from
   `accessories/cds seq.xlsx` and asserted equal to the string notebook 62
   hard-codes.
2. **The comparator is the expressed transcriptome, not the screened negative set.**
   The reporter-design question is "where does NanoLuc sit relative to a typical 231
   mRNA", not "relative to an eIF3d-protected one". The negative control set is
   genes selected for having no eIF3d effect, which makes it a contrast, not a
   background; notebook 62 carries that version.
3. **Only the NanoLuc reference lines are drawn.** Renilla and Firefly live in
   notebook 62.

All CDS metrics, genes and reporters alike, are computed on **stop-codon-free
ORFs**, and the junction + PEST tail counts as part of the reporter CDS because it
is part of what was cloned.

Nothing here writes to `output/predictive_modeling/`; outputs go to
`output/cds_reporter_design/` and `plots/`.

# Load Libraries

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(Biostrings)

source(here("code", "cds_reporter_design", "reporter_helpers.R"))
```

```{r params}
lfc_cutoff  <- 0.5
padj_cutoff <- 0.05

# The construct is NanoLuc + a 41-aa junction/ODC PEST tail. The full construct
# is what the ribosome traverses and is the line plotted. Set TRUE to also draw
# the 171-codon catalytic domain alone; its numbers print either way.
show_nanoluc_core <- FALSE

cat("lfc_cutoff =", lfc_cutoff, "| padj_cutoff =", padj_cutoff,
    "| show_nanoluc_core =", show_nanoluc_core, "\n")
```

# NanoLuc Construct: Import and Verify

```{r read_nanoluc}
nl <- load_nanoluc_construct()
```

```{r nanoluc_table}
nl_df <- tibble(
  reporter   = c("NanoLuc construct", "NanoLuc ORF only", "Junction + PEST tag"),
  cds_length = c(nchar(nl$full), nchar(nl$core), nchar(nl$pest)),
  gc_pct     = c(orf_gc_pct(nl$full), gc_pct_of(nl$core), gc_pct_of(nl$pest)),
  gc3_pct    = c(orf_gc3_pct(nl$full), compute_gc3_pct(nl$core),
                 compute_gc3_pct(nl$pest))
)

stopifnot(
  "Reporter GC% out of range"  = all(nl_df$gc_pct  >= 0 & nl_df$gc_pct  <= 100),
  "Reporter GC3% out of range" = all(nl_df$gc3_pct >= 0 & nl_df$gc3_pct <= 100)
)

print(nl_df %>% mutate(across(c(gc_pct, gc3_pct), ~ round(.x, 1))))

# Lines drawn in the main panels. Colours avoid the density-curve hues
# (grey70 / #E69F00) or a reference line would read as a gene group.
luc_df <- nl_df %>%
  filter(reporter %in% c("NanoLuc construct",
                         if (show_nanoluc_core) "NanoLuc ORF only")) %>%
  mutate(color = c("#0072B2", "#CC79A7")[seq_len(n())],
         linetype = "solid")

cat("Reference lines drawn:", paste(luc_df$reporter, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# eIF3d Hypoxia-Promoted Gene Set

```{r load_promotes}
te_hyp <- read_csv(
  here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Direction check. These files hold the sictrl_vs_si3d coefficient despite the
# filename stating the ratio the other way round, so positive te_lfc = sictrl >
# si3d = knockdown reduces it = eIF3d promotes. EIF3D's own rna_lfc must be
# strongly positive, because the siRNA depletes its target; if it is negative the
# direction has flipped and the gene set below is upside down.
eif3d_rna <- te_hyp %>% filter(symbol == "EIF3D") %>% pull(rna_lfc)
stopifnot("EIF3D rna_lfc is not strongly positive: contrast direction may be flipped" =
            length(eif3d_rna) == 1 && eif3d_rna > 2)
cat("Direction check - EIF3D rna_lfc:", round(eif3d_rna, 2),
    "(positive = knockdown depletes its target, as expected)\n")

promotes <- te_hyp %>%
  filter(te_lfc > lfc_cutoff, te_padj < padj_cutoff) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

stopifnot("Expected 1604 eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes" = nrow(promotes) == 1604)
cat("eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes (te_lfc >", lfc_cutoff,
    ", te_padj <", padj_cutoff, "):", nrow(promotes), "\n")
```

# Transcript Selection

Most abundant isoform per gene, taken from the pre-computed feature matrix
(MDA-MB-231 siCTRL normoxia). Promoted genes absent from that matrix fall back to
their most abundant isoform in the 1hr hypoxia siCTRL samples.

```{r load_feature_matrix}
fm <- readRDS(here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                   "feature_matrix_external_stability.rds"))

tx_all <- fm %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)

tx_promotes <- tx_all %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% promotes$gene_id_clean)

cat("All expressed genes in feature matrix:", nrow(tx_all), "\n")
cat("Promoted genes found in feature matrix:", nrow(tx_promotes),
    "of", nrow(promotes), "\n")
```

```{r hypoxia_fallback}
missing_gene_ids <- promotes$gene_id_clean[
  !promotes$gene_id_clean %in% tx_all$gene_id_clean
]
cat("Promoted genes not in feature matrix:", length(missing_gene_ids), "\n")

tx_map <- read_tsv(
  here("accessories", "human", "tx2gene_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv.gz"),
  col_names = c("transcript_id", "gene_id"),
  col_types = "cc"
) %>%
  filter(str_starts(transcript_id, "ENST")) %>%
  transmute(
    transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", transcript_id),
    gene_id_clean       = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)
  )

hyp_samples <- c("NM2025_0094", "NM2025_0095", "NM2025_0096")
hyp_files   <- setNames(
  file.path(here("2025_MDAcells_riboseq", "salmon"), hyp_samples, "quant.sf.gz"),
  hyp_samples
)
stopifnot("Hypoxia siCTRL quant files missing" = all(file.exists(hyp_files)))

hyp_tpm <- map_dfr(names(hyp_files), function(s) {
  read_tsv(hyp_files[[s]], col_types = "cdddd",
           col_names = c("Name", "Length", "EffectiveLength", "TPM", "NumReads"),
           skip = 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Name, TPM) %>%
    mutate(sample = s)
}) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(mean_tpm = mean(TPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", Name))

extra_tx_df <- hyp_tpm %>%
  inner_join(tx_map, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean %in% missing_gene_ids, mean_tpm > 0) %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(mean_tpm, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(promotes %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol) %>% distinct(),
            by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)

n_extra         <- nrow(extra_tx_df)
n_still_missing <- length(missing_gene_ids) - n_extra
cat("Extra transcripts from 1hr hypoxia siCTRL:", n_extra, "\n")
cat("Genes with zero hypoxia TPM (excluded):   ", n_still_missing, "\n")

tx_promotes <- bind_rows(tx_promotes, extra_tx_df)
cat("Promoted genes after fallback:", nrow(tx_promotes), "\n")
```

# CDS Sequences, Lengths, GC and GC3

```{r build_metrics}
metrics_all <- build_cds_metrics(
  here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))

expressed <- tx_all %>%
  inner_join(metrics_all, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(cds_length > 0)

promoted <- tx_promotes %>%
  inner_join(metrics_all, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(cds_length > 0)

cat("Expressed transcriptome - valid CDS:", nrow(expressed), "of", nrow(tx_all), "\n")
cat("eIF3d promoted        - valid CDS:", nrow(promoted), "of", nrow(tx_promotes), "\n")

stopifnot(
  "GC% out of range"  = all(expressed$gc_pct  >= 0 & expressed$gc_pct  <= 100),
  "GC3% out of range" = all(expressed$gc3_pct >= 0 & expressed$gc3_pct <= 100),
  "GC3 median not in expected range [40, 65]" =
    between(median(expressed$gc3_pct), 40, 65)
)

# Biological spot-check: ACTB CDS GC% expected 50-70%.
actb <- expressed %>% filter(symbol == "ACTB") %>% dplyr::slice(1)
if (nrow(actb) == 1) {
  stopifnot("ACTB CDS GC% outside expected 50-70%" = between(actb$gc_pct, 50, 70))
  cat("ACTB CDS GC%:", round(actb$gc_pct, 2),
      "| GC3%:", round(actb$gc3_pct, 2), "\n")
}
```

# Density Panels with the NanoLuc Reference Line

The grey curve is the whole expressed transcriptome, including the promoted genes,
because "where does NanoLuc sit among 231 mRNAs" is a question about the full
population. The Wilcoxon test is run against the transcriptome **excluding** the
promoted set, so the two samples being compared are disjoint, and is reported to
the console rather than annotated on the panel.

```{r density_setup}
group_cols <- c("All expressed mRNAs"    = "grey70",
                "eIF3d hypoxia promotes" = "#E69F00")
```

```{r panel_length, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_len <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed, promoted, "cds_length",
  xlab    = "CDS length (kb)",
  title   = "CDS length, MDA-MB-231",
  outfile = "cds_reporter_01_density_cds_length.pdf",
  luc_tbl = luc_df, group_cols = group_cols,
  xscale  = 1000, xmax = 6
)
```

```{r panel_gc, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_gc <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed, promoted, "gc_pct",
  xlab    = "CDS GC content (%)",
  title   = "CDS GC content, MDA-MB-231",
  outfile = "cds_reporter_01_density_cds_gc.pdf",
  luc_tbl = luc_df, group_cols = group_cols
)
```

```{r panel_gc3, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_gc3 <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed, promoted, "gc3_pct",
  xlab    = "CDS GC3 content (%)",
  title   = "CDS GC3 content, MDA-MB-231",
  outfile = "cds_reporter_01_density_cds_gc3.pdf",
  luc_tbl = luc_df, group_cols = group_cols
)
```

## The same panel with no reference lines

The gene distributions on their own, for use where the figure is making a point
about the transcriptome rather than about where a construct sits in it. Same
data, same estimator and same colors as the panel above, so the two are directly
comparable; only the reference lines are dropped.

```{r panel_gc3_nolines, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_gc3_bare <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed, promoted, "gc3_pct",
  xlab    = "CDS GC3 content (%)",
  title   = "CDS GC3 content, MDA-MB-231",
  outfile = "cds_reporter_01_density_cds_gc3_nolines.pdf",
  luc_tbl = NULL, group_cols = group_cols
)

# The two panels must differ only in the reference lines: same curves, same n,
# same medians. Comparing the built data rather than the images is what makes
# that checkable.
stopifnot(
  "The no-line panel plots different data from the panel with lines" =
    identical(dplyr::select(p_gc3$data, group, .x),
              dplyr::select(p_gc3_bare$data, group, .x)),
  "The no-line panel still carries reference lines" =
    nrow(ggplot2::layer_data(p_gc3_bare, 2)) == 0
)
cat("No-line GC3 panel matches the annotated one on data;",
    "reference lines dropped.\n")
```

# Designed NanoLuc Variants

The codon-adapted, anti-adapted, and GC3-matched negative control NanoLuc
sequences designed in `code/predictive_modeling/64_nanoluc_codon_adaptation.Rmd`,
added as reference lines alongside the parent.

Notebook 64 designed and exported these as **513 nt ORFs**, but each was cloned
with the junction + PEST tail attached, and that tail was **not** recoded for GC3.
So the sequence that actually exists, and the one the ribosome traverses, is the
recoded ORF followed by the unmodified 123 nt tail. These panels therefore plot
the **full 636 nt constructs**, on the same basis as the panels above. The ORF-only
values notebook 64 reports are kept alongside in the printed table.

The unmodified tail is not a bookkeeping detail: at GC3 51.2% it pulls both
extremes back toward the middle, so it **caps how far a construct can actually be
pushed**. The adapted ORF is GC3 3.5% but the cloned construct is 12.7%; the
anti-adapted ORF is 100% but the construct is 90.6%. Any design target should be
set on the construct, not the ORF.

The variants are **purely synonymous**, so all four constructs are the same length
and encode the same protein. The length panel is included for completeness, but
all four lines coincide there by construction. GC and GC3 are where they separate.

```{r load_designed_variants}
var_df <- load_nanoluc_variants(nl)

cat("\nORF as designed vs construct as cloned:\n")
print(var_df %>%
        dplyr::select(reporter, n_codons_changed,
                      orf_length, gc3_orf, cds_length, gc_pct, gc3_pct) %>%
        mutate(across(c(gc3_orf, gc_pct, gc3_pct), ~ round(.x, 1))))

# The negative control is GC3-matched to the parent by design, so its line falls
# exactly on the parent's. Report the collision and draw it dashed, or it would
# be hidden underneath and read as absent.
gc3_collision <-
  var_df$gc3_pct[var_df$reporter == "3d-negative control"] ==
  var_df$gc3_pct[var_df$reporter == "NanoLuc parent"]
cat("Negative control GC3 identical to parent:", gc3_collision,
    "(drawn dashed so both remain visible)\n")

# Colours avoid the density-curve hues (grey70 / #E69F00) and the two reserved
# factor hues (#E69F00 eIF3d, #56B4E9 eIF3e), so no reference line reads as a
# gene group or a knockdown.
var_plot_df <- var_df %>%
  dplyr::select(reporter, cds_length, gc_pct, gc3_pct) %>%
  mutate(
    color    = c("#0072B2", "#009E73", "#CC79A7", "black"),
    linetype = c("solid",   "solid",   "solid",   "22")
  )
```

```{r panel_variants_length, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_len_var <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed, promoted, "cds_length",
  xlab    = "CDS length (kb)",
  title   = "CDS length, MDA-MB-231, NanoLuc constructs",
  outfile = "cds_reporter_01_density_cds_length_variants.pdf",
  luc_tbl = var_plot_df, group_cols = group_cols,
  xscale  = 1000, xmax = 6
)
```

```{r panel_variants_gc, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_gc_var <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed, promoted, "gc_pct",
  xlab    = "CDS GC content (%)",
  title   = "CDS GC content, MDA-MB-231, NanoLuc constructs",
  outfile = "cds_reporter_01_density_cds_gc_variants.pdf",
  luc_tbl = var_plot_df, group_cols = group_cols
)
```

```{r panel_variants_gc3, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_gc3_var <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed, promoted, "gc3_pct",
  xlab    = "CDS GC3 content (%)",
  title   = "CDS GC3 content, MDA-MB-231, NanoLuc constructs",
  outfile = "cds_reporter_01_density_cds_gc3_variants.pdf",
  luc_tbl = var_plot_df, group_cols = group_cols
)
```

# Where NanoLuc Falls: Percentiles

```{r percentiles}
# Every reference line drawn anywhere in this notebook, on the full-construct
# basis. "NanoLuc construct" and "NanoLuc parent" are the same 636 nt sequence
# reached by two routes, so both are kept and asserted equal above.
ref_all <- bind_rows(
  luc_df      %>% dplyr::select(reporter, cds_length, gc_pct, gc3_pct),
  var_plot_df %>% dplyr::select(reporter, cds_length, gc_pct, gc3_pct)
)

pct_tbl <- reporter_percentiles(expressed, promoted, ref_all)
print(pct_tbl)

stopifnot("Percentiles must lie in [0, 100]" =
            all(pct_tbl$pct_expressed >= 0 & pct_tbl$pct_expressed <= 100 &
                pct_tbl$pct_promoted  >= 0 & pct_tbl$pct_promoted  <= 100))

write_csv(pct_tbl,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design",
               "01_nanoluc_percentiles_vs_231.csv"))
cat("Exported: output/cds_reporter_design/01_nanoluc_percentiles_vs_231.csv\n")
```

```{r group_medians}
medians_df <- tibble(
  group = c("All expressed mRNAs", "eIF3d hypoxia promotes"),
  n     = c(nrow(expressed), nrow(promoted)),
  median_len_kb  = c(median(expressed$cds_length), median(promoted$cds_length)) / 1000,
  median_gc_pct  = c(median(expressed$gc_pct),  median(promoted$gc_pct)),
  median_gc3_pct = c(median(expressed$gc3_pct), median(promoted$gc3_pct))
) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("median"), ~ round(.x, 2)))

print(medians_df)

write_csv(medians_df,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design", "01_group_medians_cds_gc.csv"))
cat("Exported: output/cds_reporter_design/01_group_medians_cds_gc.csv\n")
```

# Summary

```{r summary}
cat("=== CDS reporter design: NanoLuc vs MDA-MB-231 ===\n\n")

cat("NanoLuc construct (stop-free):", nchar(nl$full), "nt |",
    nchar(nl$full) / 3, "codons\n")
cat("  GC%  =", round(gc_pct_of(nl$full), 1),
    "| GC3% =", round(compute_gc3_pct(nl$full), 1), "\n")
cat("  = NanoLuc ORF", nchar(nl$core), "nt (GC3",
    round(compute_gc3_pct(nl$core), 1), ") + junction/PEST",
    nchar(nl$pest), "nt (GC3", round(compute_gc3_pct(nl$pest), 1), ")\n\n")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(medians_df))) {
  cat(sprintf("%-24s n = %-6s  median length %.2f kb | GC %.1f%% | GC3 %.1f%%\n",
              medians_df$group[i], fmt_n(medians_df$n[i]),
              medians_df$median_len_kb[i], medians_df$median_gc_pct[i],
              medians_df$median_gc3_pct[i]))
}
cat("\n")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(pct_tbl))) {
  cat(sprintf("%-20s %-11s %8.1f  ->  %5.1f pct of expressed, %5.1f pct of promoted\n",
              pct_tbl$reporter[i], pct_tbl$metric[i], pct_tbl$reporter_value[i],
              pct_tbl$pct_expressed[i], pct_tbl$pct_promoted[i]))
}
```
